violations.why: irq_anchor (priority 6) can preempt irq_summit between its write and read of v_falcon, so the check can see a nonzero value.
irq_anchor preempts irq_kelp between the index read and the increment, so an increment is lost and the stored slot is stale.
irq_anchor (priority 6) can preempt irq_thorn between reading v_prism and resetting it, so the bound check is stale.
irq_kelp (priority 5) can preempt irq_thorn between reading v_prism and resetting it, so the bound check is stale.
